(1) It shall be lawful for the Corporation from time to

column1: time, at any General Meeting or at a Special General Meeting

column2: the election of the office bearers, their term of office,

the  Board  of  Management  other  than  the  office

the administration and management of the property
of the Corporation, the custody of its funds and the
maintenance and audit of its accounts;
the procedure to be followed at any meeting of the
Board of Management and the quorum therefor and
the conduct of business thereat; and
the  management  of  the  affairs  of  the  Corporation
